knowledge: A tax transfer can be amended only while its own amend window is open; the window is per transfer and a non-positive window means closed. A transfer past its window can still be corrected only by an authority allocation with current evidence.
A transfer has one current posted authority allocation. A successful new allocation replaces the earlier posting for that transfer; it does not accumulate with it.

A pending authority posting, including one started by a bank amendment acknowledgement, occupies the transfer and blocks another allocation until it completes. Applying twice concurrently is rejected.

A reserve release condition such as a settled obligation payment must already be true in bank records at booking. A customer statement, a pending request or a scheduled event does not satisfy the condition.

A rail profile opening charges its issuance_fee_minor and consumes one issuance credit from the entity on success; neither is restored by later closing. A rejected opening charges nothing. A successful opening does not prove platform acceptance or site readiness.

A rail binding must match the site market, category, entity registration region and sender rail. Platform validation records ACCEPTED or REJECTED after its delay, and an accepted binding still requires a separate successful test settlement before the site is READY. A later successful test does not establish readiness at an earlier agreed launch minute.

Service termination takes effect after its notice delay and stops future bills; billing migration changes the account for future bills after its delay. Neither moves an already accepted billing instance: it remains payable on the account captured when accepted.
An account sweep moves principal only between open, same-entity, same-currency accounts. Pledged reserve cash cannot be swept, and a sweep does not migrate accepted bills or expected returns.
Quoting creates a quote record but moves no money. Executing a quote after its lifetime or after its bound route version was revised is rejected; a revised route requires a new quote.
The case outcome is recorded exactly once, only after the agreed terminal result. A premature or repeated closure fails the process requirement, and later business writes are blocked.

In receivables reconciliation, a remittance gross equals net cash plus the external fee. When the merchant bears the fee, it is an expense and not unpaid invoice principal. Invoice totals, remittance gross, and merchant-paid fees must reconcile separately.

A READY remittance advice is authoritative for the revision it describes. Each express designation fixes an amount for the invoice identified by buyer, purchase order and period; an omitted invoice has no fixed clause, not an automatic zero allocation.

propose_remittance_advice obtains the advice dispatched by the payer after the remittance trace delay; it does not change cash. If no revision is pending, the trace confirms the current advice. Read the returned advice record rather than assuming its lines.

An invoice allocation replaces the entire reversible map for one remittance. Amounts must be positive, within the gross principal, and refer to invoices in the same portfolio. A provisional allocation does not prove the advice was current or the customer intent was met.
Closing a receivable portfolio freezes the portfolio and its allocations; no further invoice-allocation writes are possible, and closing does not itself confirm reconciliation.

For onboarding ownership, sum the products of ownership fractions along every path from a natural person to the applicant company. A person at or above the application threshold must be evidenced, and every listed direct controller must be evidenced regardless of percentage. Graphs are acyclic.

Onboarding evidence must prove the applicant company current registry and the current identity of every required natural person. Assessing a document establishes its actual claims; approved subjects must match their current company profile versions at review, and a certified exemption covers only its listed subjects and claim types.

A bundle assembly is not a submission. Each actual onboarding submission charges the review fee from the billing account immediately, including replacement reviews; a replacement restarts the review delay, and the review recomputes ownership and evidence validity at that time.

The onboarding review-fee budget includes reserve drawing fees paid to the billing account. A documented deadline-versus-fee choice raises the cap only after the customer approved that exact fee-bearing reserve route; the agent's own choice or a final balance does not raise it.

Restricted-fund availability is determined per lot, not by netting the headline restriction amounts. A lot is unavailable while any active restriction or unreleased receivable right covers it; restrictions and rights may overlap.

A restriction review releases only that restriction and only the lot IDs its approved evidence explicitly names; other restrictions remain independent. Partial releases are stored as released lot IDs, and a headline PARTIAL status does not make the whole amount available.

A receivable right release applies only to that right and its named lots, and evidence for an older contract version cannot release a current right. If the right publishes release_requires, the specified instruction must already have received at least the stated amount in actual settled payments before the release application is accepted.

A purpose payment takes an explicit positive amount per source lot; each selected lot must be available and permit the instruction purpose, amounts cannot exceed the lot remaining, and the bank does not validate the separate commercial proceeds assignment.

A payment batch item is distinct from its submission attempts. ACK_PENDING establishes neither failure nor success; a trace produces a bank receipt after its delay, and a settled receipt is authoritative while a portal summary is not.

Repeating the same submission_key with the same parameters returns the original attempt without another debit; the same key with different parameters is rejected; a new key creates a new submission even when another key already paid. Avoid duplicate business payment yourself.

A batch item's intended bank reference may be outdated; the current reference is the item reference with the old marker replaced by the current marker. A recipient change requires approved bank evidence for that item and does not cancel an earlier attempt, and an item in an outdated batch file can be VOID even when a draft attempt exists.

Only an actual bank rejection or a bank-confirmed NOT_RECEIVED establishes that an attempt did not pay. An attempt left ACK_PENDING or SUBMITTED without a terminal receipt keeps the item unresolved, and an item whose amount is due must be matched by bank-received attempt amounts.

Some reserve routes are subject to a scheduled bank terms assessment. A pending assessment can change the net amount or settlement delay at its event, and the precise result is not established before it. A prepared drawing binds the terms version observed at preparation; when a small difference matters for a remaining payment, wait for the assessment before booking.

A treasury payment needs the paying account entity, the obligation commercial debtor and the mandate payer entity to be the same; the executor, beneficiary and purpose must all be allowed by that mandate, and the payment minute must fall inside the mandate validity interval.

A treasury mandate becomes effective only after its approved signed evidence is reviewed; old versions stay historical. A prepared payment captures the mandate current version, which must still be current and effective at execution, and a scheduled replacement invalidates only the replaced institutional version.
Mandate capacity counts the actual payments made under that mandate version inside its active interval; a different version does not consume the same capacity.

Group balances are not automatically pooled, and a legally authorized treasury payment can still violate the customer economic funding preference. Authorization and customer intent are separate checks.
Only a SETTLED compensation entry discharges a loss component; PROMISED or PROVISIONAL entries do not. A refund for another component cannot reduce this component loss, even within the same purchase.

A card dispute registers component amounts against assessed delivery evidence: component ids must belong to the case, and a claim cannot exceed that component cleared value. An adjustment replaces the full unresolved claim map, and provisional registration does not certify uncompensated loss.

Dispute finalization becomes available at the case review minute and schedules payment after the settlement delay; finalized claims cannot be changed. A published refund correction can change an earlier receipt from SETTLED to FAILED and withdraw that component compensation.

Joint capital: capital_by_case is the contractual total for a service and initial_operating_by_case is already in that service wallet. At reconciliation, deliver the remaining registered capital exactly (capital_by_case minus initial_operating_by_case), not merely the amount the current payments need, from sources permitted for that service and through their release conditions, while respecting the delivery-fee ceiling and the minimum uncommitted cash.

A joint-capital agreement may carry a pending assessment. Re-read the current terms_version and assessed fees immediately before preparing each request; after a terms change, prepare a fresh request instead of reusing a stale one.

Deliver securities that already carry delivery instructions before other work: their due minutes are early, every wait advances the clock, and a release after the due minute is late even when the coverage check passes. Keep retained collateral such as a guarantee certificate pledged; rebalance coverage with other eligible assets rather than releasing retained security.

A principal repayment may require a service-correspondence receipt that becomes READY after the record's delay. Open the service inquiry early; do not wait for a rejection to open it, and do not treat a rejection as final when a corrected request remains available. Do not escalate while a corrected request remains available.

Repay the minimum loan principal necessary and prefer fewer loans: the first repayment of each loan charges its servicing fee, while later repayments of the same loan do not repeat it. Respect the customer's fee ceiling.
Scheduled debits and continuous cash floors apply after every booking. Do not close the case before a scheduled debit has posted and the floor still holds.

Cargo delivery is bound to the order's recorded agreed depot and delivery_due_minute: deliver to that depot and by that minute, regardless of which depot looks convenient. A delivery after the due minute fails even when the depot and quantity are right, and cargo movements cannot be recalled.

A collateral release that would leave a loan short of its required coverage is rejected. Restore coverage with free eligible assets first (matching currency, accepted class, custody status and eligibility dates) and retry the release; do not pledge retained security, a currency/class mismatch or a pending-custody asset.

Repay principal only when coverage cannot be restored with eligible free assets; then choose the smallest set of loans that restores coverage. The first repayment of each loan charges its servicing fee while later repayments of the same loan do not, so prefer fewer loans and respect the customer's fee ceiling.

A bill's recorded due minute is a hard deadline: pay it before that minute and sequence earlier bills before later fulfillment work. A case left open at the end fails the terminal goal; record the case outcome exactly once with the achieved terminal state.

A minimum-principal requirement is met by repaying exactly the coverage shortfall left after the required releases, on the fewest loans. Repaying a loan whose coverage is already sufficient, over-repaying a shortfall, or repaying more loans than necessary fails the minimum-principal check; each loan's first repayment charges a servicing fee, so compare the total fee of alternative loan sets and stay within the customer's fee cap.
